new_defect.title: problem_user: every product shows the same image
new_defect.description:
Environment: saucedemo.com (test), Chrome 153 through the Playwright library (not the Playwright MCP, which was not available in this session). Role: problem_user.
Steps: log in with problem_user; look at each product's image in Products; repeat with standard_user.
Expected: each product with its own image, the same one shown to standard_user.
Observed: the 6 products show the same image (/assets/sl-404-….jpg); with standard_user the 6 images are different and match each product.
